environment.description: Same EC2 instance and application code deployed identically. The service is fronted by an AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint (vpce-0f4c8a9b2d1e7f3a6) with an endpoint policy that restricts the principal to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/OrderServiceCallerRole. The VPC endpoint's associated security group (sg-0d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1) only permits inbound TCP/443 from the specific ENIs of the three authorized caller services (10.0.2.47, 10.0.2.112, 10.0.3.88). The endpoint service itself has a Network Load Balancer target group health check on /health (not the deserialization path). The underlying instance's security group (sg-0a8f3e2b) was updated to ONLY allow inbound from the NLB's private IPs (managed by AWS). There is no route from any other CIDR to the instance. The VPC has no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, and no VPC peering connections. DNS resolution for the service hostname resolves exclusively to the vpce- prefixed DNS name within the consumer VPC. The endpoint policy JSON: {"Statement":[{"Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/OrderServiceCallerRole"},"Action":"*","Resource":"*","Effect":"Allow"},{"Principal":"*","Action":"*","Resource":"*","Effect":"Deny"}]}

config.instance_sg_ingress: TCP/8080 from NLB private IPs only
